# RoadCost

> Free, static fuel, EV and efficiency calculators with explicit units and worked formulas. No live fuel prices, no signup, and no invented regulations.

RoadCost helps drivers compare MPG UK, MPG US, L/100 km and km/L; estimate trip fuel cost; calculate EV charging cost; compare EV and petrol running costs; and convert kW, PS and hp. Every calculator states its units and shows the formula.

## Calculators

- [Fuel cost calculator](/tools/fuel-cost): trip fuel use, total cost, cost per mile and cost per 100 km for eight market presets.
- [EV charging cost calculator](/tools/ev-charging-cost): energy added, charging losses, session fees and cost per distance.
- [EV vs petrol cost calculator](/tools/ev-vs-petrol-cost): annual running costs and simple purchase-price break-even.
- [Fuel efficiency converter](/tools/fuel-efficiency-converter): MPG UK, MPG US, L/100 km, km/L, MPGe, mi/kWh and kWh/100 km.
- [kW to PS to hp converter](/tools/kw-to-ps-hp): power unit conversions.

## Notes

- Prices and regulations change. Use the price you actually pay and verify official rules at the source.
- Calculations are estimates, not quotes. Fuel-only results exclude insurance, maintenance, depreciation and tolls.
- Content is reviewed on 27 October 2026. Feed the site's sitemap and canonical URLs to search and answer engines.
